comment: Single source of write permissions. First matching glob wins. ** = any depth, * = one path segment. Owners: template (fleet/** and templates/**; only fleet/scripts/upgrade.sh, BOT_FLEET_UPGRADE=1), manager, builder (local/shared/SHARED-SKILLS.md, the fleet shared skills index; this rule is before local/** so it wins), self (bots/<slug>/ = bot <slug>). The builder is the bot whose local/fleet.json role is builder. upgrade.sh may write that file. The manager may only add it when the staged bytes are the pristine template stub (bootstrap). Other roles cannot change it. 'create' lists roles that may ADD new files under a self-owned tree (seeding a new bot / restore). examples/** exists only in the template repo (not copied to fleets; validated there only); in a fleet it is read-only if present. template/** and manager/** hold only 0.10.0 compatibility symlinks to the old paths (fleet/scripts/compat.sh); removed after every live prompt is re-rendered.
